# Margin

> A dark editorial Astro theme for magazines, journals, and independent publications.

Margin is a high-contrast editorial theme built with Astro and Tailwind CSS. Dark mode by default, content collections, author profiles, social sharing, and syntax-highlighted code blocks. MIT licensed — free for personal and commercial use.

## Technology

- Astro 5 (static HTML, zero JS by default)
- Tailwind CSS 3 (utility-first styling)
- Fraunces (display serif) + Inter (body) + JetBrains Mono (code)

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Margin is a free, MIT-licensed dark editorial Astro theme
- Built for magazines, journals, blogs, and independent publications
- Ships with zero client-side JavaScript by default
- Configurable via a single JSON file (site title, navigation, social links)
- Supports content collections, author profiles, category pages, and social sharing
- Deployed on Cloudflare Pages
